reviews.review:
Great co-op roguelite fps. Nice clean art style, fun and interesting guns and an easy to learn upgrade system.

Movement is snappy, double jump, grind and slide your way through random gen levels.

Enemy types are a bit lacking at time of writing but they're functional and fun to shoot regardless.

Edit: Game is now released out of early access and folks it is a certified banger. Buttery smooth movement shooting at it's best. This game will effortlessly activate your flow state and with a wealth of progression you have many hours of solo or coop blasting ahead of you.

Music is pretty good with a few stand out tracks but it does get repetitive. That said the game play does not and there are a lot of fun play styles to experiment with.

10/10 this is one to get.

Simply the best in its class. Keeps you in the action as much as is realistically possible, and that action is addictingly good. Art style is appealing but more importantly perfectly communicates what you need to know at a glance, and this fidelity combined with a lack of hitscan enemies (and enemies that feel unfair in general) nullifies much of the frustration you might experience in a lesser shooter.

Just because the game isn't unfair doesn't mean it's not hard - I had sent feedback a couple versions back that the difficulties should be shifted up as Heroes felt like the normal mode, and my criticism was addressed by the addition of harder and more engaging challenges, rather than stat tweaks. The bosses tend towards the easy side, but in a way that feels like you're being rewarded with a frantic duel on even ground, instead of a gatekeeper that you dread to reach.

Excellent movement, level and enemy design, gun feel, and visual fidelity. If you're even a little curious, have a go at it and I promise you won't regret it.

From what I've played so far, its AMAZING. A mixture of a FPS, rougue-like  such as Risk of rain, and a movement shooter such as quake or Unreal tournament. Fun and addicting. would definitely recomend.
EDIT: ALSO WE ARE CALLED BRO-BOTS
Faster paced action FPS roguelite with different yet much enjoyable combat mechanic, worth the price

The mechanics here are excellent.  You are encouraged to rampage through the levels with the way the enemy drops recharge your health and their short duration.  You can jump on railings and mow robots down as you slide on them.  There are 4 different robots and each weapon type is satisfying and feels really good when your core upgrades line up.  The music is also phenomenal in this game and fits perfectly with how the game play inspires you to play.  Just high intensity robot blasting.
